entities.summary: Fyodor Fyodorovich Buchholz, born Teodor Buchholz was a Russo-German painter and draughtsman in the Academical style, usually known for his genre pictures. A second-rate master who's been active in St. Petersburg from Tsar Alexander III's reign through World War II, Buchholz was among founding members of the Kuindzhi Society in 1909.
